records.title: Determine-Then-Ensemble: Necessity of Top-k Union for Large Language Model Ensembling
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.03777. Studies ensemble accuracy/quality for LLMs, not reducing inference cost.

records.title: MagR: Weight Magnitude Reduction for Enhancing Post-Training Quantization
records.reason: MagR is PTQ preprocessing; it reports perplexity/quantization quality but no direct latency, throughput, or energy gain attributable to MagR itself.

records.title: Statistical Perspective of Top-K Sparse Softmax Gating Mixture of Experts
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.13850. Statistical analysis of sparse softmax MoE gating, not a concrete inference optimization with runtime results.

records.title: TokenPowerBench: Benchmarking the Power Consumption of LLM Inference
records.reason: This is an inference-energy measurement benchmark rather than an optimization method.

records.title: Accelerating Streaming Video Large Language Models via Hierarchical Token Compression
records.reason: Gains target streaming VideoLLMs and video-token/ViT processing; text LLM inference applicability is not shown.
